_comment: The ONE judgment in the pipeline: which eBay category branches count as ENGINE parts (Rule B). A listing whose categoryId is a descendant of any include-ancestor -> Rule B (fitment restricted to the donor's engine). Everything else -> Rule A (whole chassis family). exclude_ids override include (forced Rule A). See docs/DESIGN.md sec 6.1. IDs are eBay US Motors (category_tree 100) branches under the roots listed in ebay_fetch_categories.DEFAULT_ROOTS (6030 Car & Truck Parts, 38635 In-Car Technology, 107057 Performance & Racing). 6030 owner-confirmed 2026-08-15; the Performance mirrors added 2026-08-24.
_default_note: If a listing's category is not in the fetched tree, default to Rule B (narrower/safer).

include_ancestors.name: Air & Fuel Delivery
include_ancestors.note: Injectors, throttle bodies, intake manifolds, fuel pumps, turbos live here.

include_ancestors.name: Engine Cooling Components
include_ancestors.note: Owner: ALL cooling incl radiators = engine.

include_ancestors.name: Starters, Alternators, ECUs & Wiring
include_ancestors.note: Owner-confirmed: starters/alternators/ECUs are engine-specific (accepts some wiring imprecision).

include_ancestors.name: Performance > Engine & Components
include_ancestors.note: Mirrors 33612. Racing engines, camshafts, crankshafts, cylinder heads, blocks, pistons, valves.

include_ancestors.name: Performance > Fuel Systems
include_ancestors.note: Mirrors 33549. Fuel injection & pumps, pressure regulators, fuel cells.

include_ancestors.name: Performance > Induction
include_ancestors.note: Mirrors 33549's note (intake manifolds, turbos). Superchargers, cold air intake, carburetors.

include_ancestors.name: Performance > Electrical Components
include_ancestors.note: Mirrors 33572 (ECUs/ignition are engine-specific): ignition, chips, programmers, tuning devices. Its 'Other' catch-all (107062) is excluded below -- see exclude_ids.

_rule_a_by_default.name: In-Car Technology, GPS & Security
_rule_a_by_default.note: Speakers, subwoofers, amps, screens, head units, alarms. No engine branch anywhere in its 77 categories.

exclude_ids.name: Performance > Electrical Components > Other
exclude_ids.note: Forced Rule A. This is a catch-all, not an engine branch -- the listings that land here are camera modules, antennas, tailgate openers. It was the single largest non-displaying category in the 2026-08-24 audit (0/27) because it defaulted to Rule B and got engine-restricted trims.
